changes.area: SPA responsive appointments and fixture privacy
changes.result: Mobile ordering now targets the rendered agenda wrapper; duplicate child-scoped parent ordering was removed; a phone-shaped test fixture was replaced with synthetic contact text.
Monthly advancement clamps to the target month end and carries the original anchor day through later months.
The API helper contract tests are now part of the package test and test:all commands.

changes.area: Test runner and migration harness safety
changes.result: The aggregate runner requires an explicit disposable test database, a unique per-run suffix, strips ambient database overrides, limits child environment, and supports process-tree cancellation and timeout. REM-016 migration children now run as cancellable process groups; SIGINT/SIGTERM cleanup in finally is source-reviewed but was not signal-tested or harness-executed. The harness accepts only digest-pinned official PostgreSQL image names; output paths reject traversal, symlinks, and overwrite; cleanup failures prevent a PASS report.

Artifact and architecture evidence writes stay in-repository, refuse symlinks and overwrites, and suppress absolute roots. Static skip checks reject computed/local/imported/destructured test API aliases, including namespace-import destructuring and computed destructured modifier keys; dynamic test options fail closed across test, it, suite and describe calls. CI validation removes shell comments, here-document bodies and multiline-quoted text, rejects masked commands and commands in conditional or continue-on-error job/step scopes, and requires the Redis GITHUB_ENV export to be a standalone top-level group. The final bounded I1 review found `git log --output` could write through a RUNNER_TEMP glob to the active add_path file; the validator now checks dynamic git-log output targets and the fixture covers the exact command. This local fix passed focused checks, but the changed validator and fixture bytes have no post-fix I1 review and remain HOLD.

The protected state ignore rule is present and the file mode is 0644. The install runbook no longer links internal evidence; the role matrix discloses that NOINHERIT and migration-role memberships remain unrecorded and open for candidate-bound proof.
